subject: Final go/no-go confirmation & signature timing — proposed start window
messages:
From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@stellarretail.com>

Cc: procurement@stellarretail.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Last-mile questions before signature — timing & start date

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning. We ran the internal review with procurement and the cloud team; a couple quick asks so we can lock the PO and DocuSign routing today: 

- Can you confirm final signers (legal / finance / executive) and the order you want DocuSign routed? We need to show the sequence to our approvers.
- What is the earliest operational start date we should put on the SOW once signatures clear? Our onboarding window is the week of June 14–18 and we prefer an in-contract start that aligns with that.
- Any outstanding items on the MAP that would block execution if we sign by EOD Friday? We have a short approval horizon from our CFO.

I attached the internal MAP appendix we maintain for procurement for context — will share PO once routing is confirmed.

Sarah Chen
Head of Cloud Programs
Stellar Retail

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Last-mile questions before signature — timing & start date

Sarah — thanks for the clear list. Short answers and plan below.

1) Signer order (DocuSign suggested routing):
   - Legal (Stellar) -> CFO (Stellar) -> Redwood Legal (Marissa) -> Redwood Finance (Aditya) -> Exec (optional final witness by Kimberly)
   - If Stellar prefers parallel routing of Legal + CFO, we can accept but prefer sequential for audit clarity.

2) Start date:
   - We recommend putting the operational start as 2027-06-14 (first day of your onboarding week). That gives us two business days after final signature to provision dedicated pools and schedule the onboarding slot.

3) Outstanding MAP items:
   - Deployment SLOs: agreed, small doc update pending (attached SOW v2)
   - Data residency addendum: already accepted in email thread with your security team
   - Billing cadence: finance to confirm net-30 on PO — Aditya will loop in details below.

If you can confirm the signer sequence (legal -> CFO -> Marissa -> Aditya -> Kimberly) we will prepare the DocuSign envelope and attach SOW_Redwood_v2.docx and the MAP appendix. Planning to route tomorrow AM if you greenlight.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Lead | Redwood Inference

Adding technical confirmation from our side:

- Provisioning timeline: once we have signed SOW and a provisioning flag from finance (PO or confirmation of billing terms), we can reserve the Dedicated capacity and complete network/vpc prep within 48–72 hours.
- Onboarding ramp: recommend blocking the 2-day onboarding slot starting 2027-06-14 (first half: infra and network; second half: model load + smoke tests).
- Contingency: if signature slips beyond 2027-06-10, we may need to prioritize the slot vs other queued work — we will communicate immediately and offer the next available window within one week.

Quick technical ask for Stellar: please confirm the AWS account ID we should allowlist for cross-account provisioning (reply directly to me).

—Dev

Sarah / team — looping in final legal / commercial confirmation. 

- DocuSign envelope will include: SOW_Redwood_v2.docx, MAP_StellarRetail_v3.pdf, and our standard Data Processing Addendum.

If we get the PO and confirmation of signer order by tomorrow morning (Fri 28 May 09:00 PT), we will route DocuSign on Friday and target an official start date of 2027-06-14 in the SOW.

Best,
